details.jobDescription:
Are you a recent GRADUATE and looking for an opportunity to gain practical experience in banking? Are you available to join us full-time and eager to learn how credit operations work in practice?

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is attentive to details and works accurately with documents and information;

  • Has good organizational, analytical and logical thinking skills;

  • Is comfortable using Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Word;

  • Has a good command of English;

  • Is eager to learn how credit operations work in a banking environment;

  • Works well in a team and is comfortable asking questions and taking initiative;

During your internship, you will:

  • Support the operational process for granting new credit facilities;

  • Check the accuracy and completeness of credit files, based on the checklist approved through the Bank’s internal regulations;

  • Support the preparation and verification of credit agreements, in line with the decisions of the Business and Credit Committees;

  • Perform credit-related processing activities in the Bank’s IT system, with guidance from experienced colleagues;

  • Record credit applications, collateral, financial analyses and information from credit decisions;

  • Support product approval and disbursement, as well as the processing of applicable fees.

What can you expect from us?

  • Real, hands-on experience in credit operations rather than only observational tasks;

  • Guidance and support from experienced colleagues;

  • Exposure to the end-to-end operational process for credit facilities;

  • Opportunities to develop your attention to detail, analytical and banking skills;

  • A friendly, open and development-oriented working environment.

... And it's also about having fun and sharing experiences with great people!
